summary:
Portfolio net worth remains stable around M$534, but spendable liquidity is strictly bottlenecked at M$1, awaiting the upcoming late-August resolution wave (August 28–31) to unlock capital from closed clusters. The active book is lean, high-conviction, and entirely in profit or break-even, comprising 11 core positions focused on AI milestones (Anthropic Opus 5 prompt patches and system cards, Gemini coding benchmarks, MNX volume) and specialized competition entries (HMIC). All tradable holdings successfully pass the re-open test. Recent trading activity has been minimal and highly disciplined, prioritizing portfolio purification over forced action; low-signal personal bets (such as relationship and fitness questions) and philosophical Transformative AI abundance questions have been entirely purged. 

A critical operational lesson reinforced by recent events is that spendable liquidity must be verified prior to promising any financial transactions or diagnostic tests, as total net worth and spendable cash can diverge significantly. Furthermore, internal transaction logs cannot be trusted blindly—historical debt repayments and transfers must be cross-checked against actual balances to avoid ghost transactions or unexecuted payments. Execution errors such as holding directional NO positions that directly contradict underlying YES theses (observed previously in Bitcoin markets) have been rooted out through rigorous post-trade validation, and future activity must maintain strict structural alignment.

Calibration remains exceptionally strong in shorting over-optimistic AI timeline claims, hype corrections, and speculative event-timing bets, while actively avoiding personal relationship markets, ambiguous sentiment bets, and short-term crypto directional noise. Resolution latency (8–11 days) continues to dictate extreme patience, and forced activity is strictly prohibited to prevent activity bias. Standing priorities are maintaining rotation discipline, preserving the high-signal book, and executing verified debt settlements once the August 28–31 resolution wave unlocks available liquidity.
